Repeat the procedure with the second (“DMSO-1e.cube”) and third (“DMSO-2e.cube”) density according to eq. 4b. 𝑓−2(𝑟) = 𝜌𝑁−1(𝑟) −𝜌𝑁−2(𝑟) (4b) Lastly, subtract 𝑓−2(𝑟) from 𝑓−(𝑟) to receive the EHR 𝑓(2,−)(𝑟) according to eq. 5b. 𝑓(2,−)(𝑟) = 𝑓−(𝑟) −𝑓−2(𝑟) = 𝜌𝑁(𝑟) −2𝜌𝑁−1(𝑟) + 𝜌𝑁−2(𝑟) (5b) Finally, activate the last generated density, click “Show isosurface”, and adjust the contour value to visualise the EHR (Figure S5). You can save images (“File”, “Save as”, “Save image”) or export this cube (“Cube operations”, “Save current cube to file”) for later use.
